entities.name: Babylonian Exile
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The forced deportation of Judean elites to Babylon (586–538 BCE) following Nebuchadnezzar's destruction of Jerusalem and the First Temple. This trauma catalyzed the editing of the Torah, the development of synagogue worship, and messianic expectation — transforming Israelite religion into Judaism.
